segments.sn16.10:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākassapo sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.sn16.10:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yenāyasmā mahākassapo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn16.10:1.4: “āyāma, bhante kassapa, yena aññataro bhikkhunupassayo tenupasaṅkamissāmā”ti.
segments.sn16.10:1.5: “Gaccha tvaṃ, āvuso ānanda, bahukicco tvaṃ bahukaraṇīyo”ti.
segments.sn16.10:1.6: Dutiyampi kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn16.10:1.7: “āyāma, bhante kassapa, yena aññataro bhikkhunupassayo tenupasaṅkamissāmā”ti.
segments.sn16.10:1.8: “Gaccha tvaṃ, āvuso ānanda, bahukicco tvaṃ bahukaraṇīyo”ti.
segments.sn16.10:1.9: Tatiyampi kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn16.10:1.10: “āyāma, bhante kassapa, yena aññataro bhikkhunupassayo tenupasaṅkamissāmā”ti.
segments.sn16.10:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya āyasmatā ānandena pacchāsamaṇena yena aññataro bhikkhunupassayo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.sn16.10:2.2: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhuniyo yenāyasmā mahākassapo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
segments.sn16.10:2.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmā mahākassapo dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
segments.sn16.10:2.4: Atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo tā bhikkhuniyo dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
segments.sn16.10:3.1: Atha kho thullatissā bhikkhunī anattamanā anattamanavācaṃ nicchāresi –
segments.sn16.10:3.2: “kiṃ pana ayyo mahākassapo, ayyassa ānandassa vedehamunino sammukhā dhammaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ maññati?
segments.sn16.10:3.3: Seyyathāpi nāma sūcivāṇijako sūcikārassa santike sūciṃ vikketabbaṃ maññeyya;
segments.sn16.10:3.4: evameva ayyo mahākassapo ayyassa ānandassa vedehamunino sammukhā dhammaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ maññatī”ti.
segments.sn16.10:4.1: Assosi kho āyasmā mahākassapo thullatissāya bhikkhuniyā imaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānāya.
segments.sn16.10:4.2: Atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn16.10:4.3: “kiṃ nu kho, āvuso ānanda, ahaṃ sūcivāṇijako, tvaṃ sūcikāro;
segments.sn16.10:4.6: “Āgamehi tvaṃ, āvuso ānanda, mā te saṅgho uttari upaparikkhi”.
segments.sn16.10:5.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, āvuso ānanda, api nu tvaṃ bhagavato sammukhā bhikkhusaṅghe upanīto –
segments.sn16.10:5.3: ‘ahaṃ, bhikkhave, yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
segments.sn16.10:5.4: Ānandopi, bhikkhave, yāvadeva ākaṅkhati vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatī’”ti?
segments.sn16.10:6.1: “Ahaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavato sammukhā bhikkhusaṅghe upanīto –
segments.sn16.10:6.2: ‘ahaṃ, bhikkhave, yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
segments.sn16.10:6.3: Kassapopi, bhikkhave, yāvadeva ākaṅkhati vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi … pe … paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatī’ti … pe ….(Navannaṃ anupubbavihārasamāpattīnaṃ pañcannañca abhiññānaṃ evaṃ vitthāro veditabbo.)
segments.sn16.10:7.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, āvuso ānanda, api nu tvaṃ bhagavato sammukhā bhikkhusaṅghe upanīto –
segments.sn16.10:7.3: ‘ahaṃ, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmi.
segments.sn16.10:7.4: Ānandopi, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’”ti?
segments.sn16.10:8.1: “Ahaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavato sammukhā bhikkhusaṅghe upanīto –
segments.sn16.10:8.2: ‘ahaṃ, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmi.
segments.sn16.10:8.3: Kassapopi, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’”ti.
segments.sn16.10:9.1: “Sattaratanaṃ vā, āvuso, nāgaṃ aḍḍhaṭṭhamaratanaṃ vā tālapattikāya chādetabbaṃ maññeyya, yo me cha abhiññā chādetabbaṃ maññeyyā”ti.
segments.sn16.10:10.1: Cavittha ca pana thullatissā bhikkhunī brahmacariyamhāti.

lines: Na lābhasakkārahetu, kammaṭṭhānatthikā panettha bhikkhuniyo atthi, tā ussukkāpetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathāpessāmīti yācati.
Nanu ca so sayampi tepiṭako bahussuto, kiṃ sayaṃ kathetuṃ na sakkotīti?
Buddhapaṭibhāgassa pana sāvakassa kathaṃ saddhātabbaṃ maññissantīti yācati.
Bahukicco tvaṃ bahukaraṇīyoti kiṃ thero navakammādipasuto, yena naṃ evamāhāti?
No, satthari pana parinibbute catasso parisā ānandattheraṃ upasaṅkamitvā,“bhante, idāni kassa pattacīvaraṃ gahetvā caratha, kassa pariveṇaṃ sammajjatha, kassa mukhodakaṃ dethā”ti rodanti paridevanti.
Thero “aniccā saṅkhārā, vuddhasarīrepi nillajjova maccurājā pahari.
Esā saṅkhārānaṃ dhammatā, mā socittha, mā paridevitthā”ti parisaṃ saññāpeti.
Paṇḍito hi ñāṇasaṅkhātena vedena īhati sabbakiccāni karoti, tasmā “vedeho”ti vuccati.
Vedeho ca so muni cāti, vedehamuni.
Dhammaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ maññatīti tipiṭakadharassa dhammabhaṇḍāgārikassa sammukhe sayaṃ araññavāsī paṃsukūliko samāno “dhammakathiko ahan”ti dhammaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ maññati.
Mā te saṅgho uttari upaparikkhīti mā bhikkhusaṅgho atirekaokāse taṃ upaparikkhīti.
“ānandena buddhapaṭibhāgo sāvako vārito, ekā bhikkhunī na vāritā, tāya saddhiṃ santhavo vā sineho vā bhavissatī”ti mā taṃ saṅgho evaṃ amaññīti.
Idāni attano buddhapaṭibhāgabhāvaṃ dīpento taṃ kiṃ maññasi, āvusotiādimāha?
Aḍḍhaṭṭharatanaṃ vāti aḍḍharatanena ūnaaṭṭharatanaṃ, purimapādato paṭṭhāya yāva kumbhā vidatthādhikasattahatthubbedhanti attho.

Cavitthāti cutā, na matā vā naṭṭhā vā, buddhapaṭibhāgassa pana sāvakassa upavādaṃ vatvā mahākassapatthere chahi abhiññāhi sīhanādaṃ nadante tassā kāsāvāni kaṇṭakasākhā viya kacchusākhā viya ca sarīraṃ khādituṃ āraddhāni, tāni hāretvā setakāni nivatthakkhaṇeyevassā cittassādo udapādīti.

Lābhasakkārahetupi ekacce bhikkhū bhikkhunupassayaṃ gantvā bhikkhuniyo ovadanti, evamevaṃ ayaṃ pana thero na lābhasakkārahetu bhikkhunupassayagamanaṃ yācati, atha kasmāti āha “kammaṭṭhānatthikā”tiādi.

Eso hi ānandatthero ussukkāpetvā paṭipattiguṇaṃ dassento yasmā tā bhikkhuniyo catusaccakammaṭṭhānikā, tasmā pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ udayabbayādipakāsaniyā dhammakathāya vipassanāpaṭipattisampadaṃ dassesi.
Aniccādilakkhaṇāni ceva udayabbayādike ca sammā dassesi.

Samuttejesīti vipassanāya āraddhāya saṅkhārānaṃ udayabbayādīsu upaṭṭhahantesu yathākālaṃ paggahasamupekkhaṇehi bojjhaṅgānaṃ anupavattanena bhāvanāmajjhimavīthiṃ pāpetvā yathā vipassanāñāṇaṃ suppasannaṃ hutvā vahati, evaṃ indriyānaṃ visadabhāvakaraṇena vipassanācittaṃ sammā uttejesi, nibbānavasena vā samādapesi.
Sampahaṃsesīti tathā pavattiyamānāya vipassanāya samappavattabhāvanāvasena upari laddhabbabhāvanāvasena cittaṃ sampahaṃsesi, laddhassādavasena suṭṭhu tosesi.
“Bālā bhikkhunī dubbhāsitaṃ āhā”ti avatvā “khamatha, bhante”ti vadantena pakkhapātena viya vuttaṃ hotīti āha “ekā bhikkhunī na vāritā”tiādi.
